text:
ari: heads-up: nightly metrics show ~12% of `chat.complete` traffic still landing on v1 after we flipped the default. small set of tenants only.

mira: which tenants and which path? any pattern in regions or SDK versions?

ari: mostly enterprise tenants behind managed gateways, region eu-west. sketchy signal that older gateway strips `Api-Version` header.

devops-bot: rollout: `default_to_v2` flag -> completed 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC.

jon: if headers are stripped, cookie or pin will determine routing. do we log `header_present` anywhere?

sophie: yes, but dashboards aggregate by request count, not token-weighted. one tenant is heavy tokens so it amplifies impact.

ari: quick query used:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) tokens, count(*) reqs, count_if(header_present) hdrs
FROM requests_24h
WHERE effective_version = 'v1'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
results show acct-214 and acct-998 top of list. both use a managed gateway vendor.

mira: we should add an edge-side metric `header_stripped_by_proxy` if x-forwarded-for shows known vendor IP ranges. also a `cookie_affinity_ttl` gauge per region.

jon: we recently changed cookie TTLs in apac but maybe eu-west got misapplied. ops-team, can you confirm?

ops-team: confirmed: eu-west sticky-cookie TTL was accidentally set to 60m during the last edge rollout. expected 5m. patch in progress.

ari: good catch. secondary ask: can we surface per-tenant version breakdown in Console -> Traffic with a token-weighted toggle? product wants to drive outreach prioritization.

sophie: product+SE need a `force-to-v2 (30m)` debug button but gated to staff. must show preflight: est tokens/hour delta and warning if tenant has v1-only prompt templates.

mira: telemetry-wise, current trace sampler favored v2 to monitor rollout (v2=15%, v1=2%). we have poor traces for v1. propose temporary uniform sampling 8% for both versions for 48h and a special tag `legacy_routing_debug=true` on any forced debug flips.

jon: related: routing precedence is currently: console_pin > header > cookie > default. support historically wanted pins to be absolute, but that blocks header-driven client upgrades. recommend change to header > console_pin > cookie, with a `soft_pin` mode for support.

ari: that is a significant behavior change. if we flip precedence we need a canary (5%) and an automatic rollback if pinned tenants see >25% token delta or any functional failures reported.

ops-team: create canary job pc-legacy-precedence-1 starts 1733337000, watch 60m. we can auto-revert on errors.

sophie: console UX: show a badge on pinned tenants: "Pin blocks client header" with a `temporarily allow header` action that keeps pin metadata but yields to header for 72h. audit log entry required.

mira: add metrics to monitor: `pinned_vs_header_conflict_count`, `token_delta_on_pin_change`, `header_present_pct_by_tenant`. also log `proxy_fingerprint` when header missing (to map vendor).

ari: action items:
- ops-team: fix eu-west cookie TTL and roll immediately (watch 15m)
- mira: flip trace sampling to uniform 8% for 48h and add legacy_routing_debug tag for debug flips
- jon: implement header-first precedence canary with rollback hooks (5% tenants)
- sophie: design `force-to-v2 (30m)` debug button mock and preflight modal; include SE contact link
- ari: collect anonymized request examples for the two largest tenants and notify SEs

ops-team: acked. deploying TTL patch now.

mira: I'll add the per-tenant token-weighted bar to the Traffic dashboard and expose `proxy_fingerprint` histogram.

ari: thanks. if anyone on this thread is in contact with acct-214/998, please ping SE to warn them before we run the canary. we'll keep monitoring in #eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
